title: Validate negative Reorder Quantity for Fixed Reorder Qty. planning
summary: Item, Item Template, and Stockkeeping Unit now reject negative Reorder Quantities with a clear validation error, and planning failures for Fixed Reorder Qty. policy are replaced with actionable error messages.
key_points: Added MinValue = 0 constraint to Reorder Quantity field across Item, Item Template, and Stockkeeping Unit tables in all country layers
Inventory Profile Offsetting codeunit now validates negative reorder quantities and reports them with the actual value instead of hard-coded 0
Existing negative values fail on next validation instead of causing internal planning errors
Planning resiliency ensures errors are logged in Planning Error Log with details
New test added to verify clear error messaging for negative reorder quantities
